title: RTP player: It is possible to select SETUP packet related to RTP stream
description:
When SETUP (or related signalling packet) exists, it is selected by
Shift+G. If RTP stream is "alone", first RTP packet of the stream is
selected.

commits_data.message:
RTP player: It is possible to select SETUP packet related to RTP stream

When SETUP (or related signalling packet) exists, it is selected by
Shift+G. If RTP stream is "alone", first RTP packet of the stream is
selected.
